contentList.content: Vludber calls his favourite Game: he splits every other creature in the fight into two teams and stops fighting himself. While both teams still have living members, he takes no actions, and creatures that are not players cannot harm him. The party still can, and killing the Commentator ends the Game at once. A creature that leaves the fight during the Game dies, and a player who kills a member of their own team dies as well.

The Game is on. While both teams still have living members, Vludber takes no actions and watches from the stage. Creatures that are not players cannot harm him; the party can, and killing him ends the Game at once. He rejoins the fight as soon as one team is entirely dead.
Vludber has forced this creature into his Game. It wins by killing every creature of Team Chaotic. Killing a member of its own team, or leaving the fight during the Game, means instant death.
Vludber has forced this creature into his Game. It wins by killing every creature of Team Lawful. Killing a member of its own team, or leaving the fight during the Game, means instant death.

Vludber declares a Game!

Every combatant has been sorted into the Team Lawful or the Team Chaotic.

The Game ends when one of the teams is entirely dead!

Or put the Commentator himself down to bring the curtain down early!

Eliminated creatures cannot be resurrected!

Anyone who flees the battle dies on the spot!

And whoever kills their own team-mate dies on the spot!
Eliminated from Vludber's Game. While the Game is on, resurrection is blocked. Once one team is entirely dead, the fallen can be raised again.
